shows.title: Severance
shows.overview: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.

episodes.title: Good News About Hell
episodes.overview: Mark is promoted to lead a team who've had their memories surgically divided between their work and personal lives.

episodes.title: Half Loop
episodes.overview: The team train new hire Helly on macrodata refinement. Mark takes a day off to meet with a mysterious former colleague.

episodes.title: In Perpetuity
episodes.overview: Mark takes the team on a field trip, but Helly continues to rebel. A deteriorating Petey struggles to tell Mark about Lumon’s misdeeds.

episodes.title: The You You Are
episodes.overview: Irving finds an intriguing book at work. Helly aggressively pursues a meeting with her Outie. Mark attends a funeral with Ms. Selvig.

episodes.title: The Grim Barbarity of Optics and Design
episodes.overview: Irving and Dylan confront Burt about his lies. Mark and Helly discover a strange new department.

episodes.title: Hide and Seek
episodes.overview: The team angers Cobel by forming an alliance.

episodes.title: Defiant Jazz
episodes.overview: Mark and the team encounter new security measures from Cobel.

episodes.title: What's for Dinner?
episodes.overview: The team prepares a plan. Mark attends Devon and Ricken’s party.

episodes.title: The We We Are
episodes.overview: The team discovers troubling revelations.

shows.title: Silo
shows.overview: In a ruined and toxic future, thousands live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette starts to uncover shocking secrets and the truth about the silo.

episodes.title: Freedom Day
episodes.overview: Sheriff Becker's plans for the future are thrown off course after his wife meets a hacker with information about the silo.

episodes.title: Holston's Pick
episodes.overview: Juliette, an engineer, pieces together what might have led to a co-worker's mysterious death.

episodes.title: Machines
episodes.overview: In her hunt for a new sheriff, Mayor Jahns clashes with Bernard. Juliette strikes a deal to keep the generator running.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.overview: Juliette tries gaining the trust of Deputy Marnes as they work to uncover the truth about recent tragedies.

episodes.title: The Janitor's Boy
episodes.overview: Sims appoints Billings as chief deputy to keep tabs on Juliette, whose efforts to solve two murders lead to a showdown.

episodes.title: The Relic
episodes.overview: During her investigation, Juliette uncovers disturbing secrets about someone she thought she knew.

episodes.title: The Flamekeepers
episodes.overview: Bernard seeks Juliette's cooperation as he grows increasingly concerned about the silo's security. Juliette asks her father for a favor.

episodes.title: Hanna
episodes.overview: New information causes Juliette to see her family's past differently—and she finally gains access to the silo's biggest secrets.

episodes.title: The Getaway
episodes.overview: Racked with guilt, Billings sets off on a personal mission, only to discover a mind-blowing clue from Juliette.

episodes.title: Outside
episodes.overview: Juliette's fate seems sealed when certain truths finally come to light.

shows.title: Slow Horses
shows.overview: Follow a dysfunctional team of MI5 agents—and their obnoxious boss, the notorious Jackson Lamb—as they navigate the espionage world's smoke and mirrors to defend England from sinister forces.

episodes.title: Circle of Life
episodes.overview: River braces for his grandfather's funeral. Lamb looks into the death of an ex–Slow Horse.

episodes.title: Daddy Issues
episodes.overview: The reemergence of Frank Harkness and a suspicious string of murders put Lamb and team on high alert.

episodes.title: Resurrection
episodes.overview: Ex–Slow Horses return to the fold as assassins close in. Taverner faces the fallout of her TV interview.

episodes.title: Lost & Found
episodes.overview: Lamb tries figuring out who Frank is working for. Sid, River, and Coe do everything to evade the hit squad.

episodes.title: Sayonara
episodes.overview: River goes after Sid. Lamb sets his sights on Cantor. Taverner carries on with a treacherous deal.

episodes.title: Judgement Day
episodes.overview: The safe house becomes unsafe as Lamb and Taverner finally join forces.

shows.title: Stranger Things
shows.overview: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces, and one strange little girl.

episodes.title: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers
episodes.overview: On his way home from a friend's house, young Will sees something terrifying. Nearby, a sinister secret lurks in the depths of a government lab.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Weirdo on Maple Street
episodes.overview: Lucas, Mike and Dustin try to talk to the girl they found in the woods. Hopper questions an anxious Joyce about an unsettling phone call.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: Holly, Jolly
episodes.overview: An increasingly concerned Nancy looks for Barb and finds out what Jonathan's been up to. Joyce is convinced Will is trying to talk to her.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: The Body
episodes.overview: Refusing to believe Will is dead, Joyce tries to connect with her son. The boys give Eleven a makeover. Nancy and Jonathan form an unlikely alliance.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: The Flea and the Acrobat
episodes.overview: Hopper breaks into the lab while Nancy and Jonathan confront the force that took Will. The boys ask Mr. Clarke how to travel to another dimension.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: The Monster
episodes.overview: A frantic Jonathan looks for Nancy in the darkness, but Steve's looking for her, too. Hopper and Joyce uncover the truth about the lab's experiments.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Bathtub
episodes.overview: Eleven struggles to reach Will, while Lucas warns that "the bad men are coming." Nancy and Jonathan show the police what Jonathan caught on camera.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Upside Down
episodes.overview: Dr. Brenner holds Hopper and Joyce for questioning while the boys wait with Eleven in the gym. Back at Will's, Nancy and Jonathan prepare for battle.

shows.title: The Bear
shows.overview: Carmy, a young fine-dining chef, comes home to Chicago to run his family sandwich shop. As he fights to transform the shop and himself, he works alongside a rough-around-the-edges crew that ultimately reveal themselves as his chosen family.

episodes.title: System
episodes.overview: Carmy attempts to retrain the employees of The Original Beef of Chicagoland, but is faced with resistance; in need of back-up, he brings on a talented young chef to help.

episodes.title: Hands
episodes.overview: A surprise health inspection reveals the cracks in the restaurant's foundation. Carmy goes head-to-head with Richie.

episodes.title: Brigade
episodes.overview: Carmy attends Al-Anon. Sydney struggles to gain the respect of the staff.

episodes.title: Dogs
episodes.overview: Carmy and Richie cater a kid's birthday party. Tina and Sydney work together while Marcus makes donuts.

episodes.title: Sheridan
episodes.overview: Things go wrong in the kitchen. Sydney finds solutions.

episodes.title: Ceres
episodes.overview: Richie notices the neighborhood is changing. Sugar and Carmy clean up the office.

episodes.title: Review
episodes.overview: A bad day in the kitchen causes tensions to rise.

episodes.title: Braciole
episodes.overview: Things get out of control. Carmy is faced with a decision.

shows.title: Wednesday
shows.overview: Smart, sarcastic and a little dead inside, Wednesday Addams investigates twisted mysteries while making new friends — and foes — at Nevermore Academy.

episodes.title: Wednesday's Child Is Full of Woe
episodes.overview: When a deliciously wicked prank gets Wednesday expelled, her parents ship her off to Nevermore Academy, the boarding school where they fell in love.

episodes.title: Woe Is the Loneliest Number
episodes.overview: The sheriff questions Wednesday about the night's strange happenings. Later, Wednesday faces off against a fierce rival in the cutthroat Poe Cup race.

episodes.title: Friend or Woe
episodes.overview: Wednesday stumbles on a secret society. During Outreach Day, Nevermore's outcasts mingle with Jericho's normies in Pilgrim World. Fudge, anyone?

episodes.title: Woe What a Night
episodes.overview: Wednesday asks Xavier to the Rave'N dance, sparking Tyler's jealousy — but Thing's got something up his sleeve. Meanwhile, Eugene stakes out the cave.

episodes.title: You Reap What You Woe
episodes.overview: During Parents Weekend, Wednesday digs into her family's past — and accidentally gets her dad arrested. Enid feels the pressure to "wolf out."

episodes.title: Quid Pro Woe
episodes.overview: Wednesday's friends throw her a surprise birthday party. They mean well... but she'd much rather mark the miserable occasion by solving the murders.

episodes.title: If You Don't Woe Me by Now
episodes.overview: Kooky Uncle Fester pays a visit and shares his theory about the monster. Wednesday begrudgingly agrees to a date with Tyler at Crackstone's crypt.

episodes.title: A Murder of Woes
episodes.overview: Wednesday lands in trouble with Principal Weems, but that's just the start of her problems. To fight an ancient evil, she'll need all her friends’ help.
